game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Coastal Port – Salt Pans, salt evaporation pans: the harbor master must handle sea serpents while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Rule Duel: Write rules that beat the AI's chosen move in a best-of-rounds duel.
theme: Coastal Port – Salt Pans: salt evaporation pans
core_gameplay_loop: In Salt Pans, repeat each round: Write rules that beat the AI's chosen move in a best-of-rounds duel. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the duel_hp value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about duel_hp to power up the harbor master and open the dock crane.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 2 (intro tier): Rule Duel
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rule Duel' (Week 3 slot 11), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Salt Pans'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how duel_hp changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sea serpents in Salt Pans.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 10.
